scope: Static review of the narrow Root-owned 0600 execution-record read fix; no Cargo, native, Root, or qualification execution by this reviewer.

reviewed_scripts.role: complete final harness with record read fix
Root17-only diagnostic with record read fix

findings: The original failure remains a failed harness attempt: its actual Root toolchain recorder completed successfully, but the operator attempted to read a Root-owned 0600 execution.json before the existing ownership transfer. This patch does not relabel that attempt as a successful Root test.

The added sudo helper is read-only. It requires actual UID/EUID 0, the exact canonical records parent owned by the invoking operator, an immediate .execution.json child, and an O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW parent descriptor.

The child is opened relative to the held parent descriptor with O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK. The helper requires a Root-owned regular file with nlink 1 and size 1..65536 bytes, then reads only bounded bytes.

Actual file descriptor, no-follow path, parent descriptor and parent path identity are checked before and after. The identity includes device, inode, mode, ownership, link count, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns. File bytes, byte count and SHA256 are returned with the original parsed record.

The operator validates the exact step path and proof, the original terminal/no-timeout/no-truncation status, source/tested SHA, lane, command and clean before/after source identity before invoking the existing ownership transfer.
After transfer, exact bytes and SHA256 must equal the read-only Root proof, then the original read_execution validation checks the execution record and original log.

Read failures or unclassified/unknown completion set completion_unknown before raising. They do not enable early chown, later Cargo, collector launch, cache mutation, signal-based supervision, or cleanup of live/unknown processes.
The original four Root program bodies, other nineteen functions, finally cleanup ordering and end-of-run unknown-process wait were mechanically compared and remain byte-identical.

No changes were made to source checkers, the Root17 parent roster, source-bound helper verification, test filtering, original just/nextest execution, UID0 requirements, Root bind identity checks, or authority.
conclusion: No concrete blocking issue found in this narrow static review. Parent may execute the fixed, separately registered diagnostic request; runtime behavior and all native/Root results remain pending actual execution.
